claim: The public record documents 159 adjudicated U.S. Lithuanian religious institutions: 82 canonical case-filed identities, 51 additional multi-source corroborated identities, and 26 attested in one published source pending corroboration.
inclusionRule: Count one canonical entity when country is US, record type is parish, misija, or congregation, and identity adjudication places it in public_us_institution scope.
